Name: Simple Harvest Dates
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b]Simple Harvest Dates[/b]
See when your crops will be ready with a clear, vanilla-style panel beside seed tooltips.
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]First harvest date:[/b] See when seeds planted today will mature.[/*]
[*][b]Last planting date:[/b] Know how late you can plant before the growing season ends.[/*]
[*][b]Harvest count:[/b] See how many harvests one planting can produce, including regrowing crops.[/*]
[*][b]Planted-crop previews:[/b] Hover over growing crops to check their next harvest.[/*]
[*][b]Soil-aware previews:[/b] Hold seeds over tilled soil to account for its fertilizer and applicable nearby-water growth bonus.[/*]
[*][b]Growth bonuses:[/b] Accounts for Agriculturist and the game’s native growth-speed bonuses.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic layout:[/b] Moves around detected tooltips, panels and text, adjusting wrapping to stay on screen.[/*]
[*][b]Modded crops:[/b] Reads loaded crop data, including compatible custom crops.[/*]
[*][b]12 languages:[/b] Follows your game’s selected language.[/*]
[/list]Forecasts assume daily watering and prompt harvesting. Fully custom mod interfaces may need additional compatibility support.
[heading]Installation[/heading]
Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.4.0+[/b].
Extract [b]SimpleHarvestDates[/b] into your [b]Mods[/b] folder and launch through SMAPI.

Manifest.Name: Simple Harvest Dates
Manifest.Description: A separate harvest panel beside seed tooltips, with planting dates and growth forecasts.
